I replied to Dana in a thread on their message in #north-team: "Thanks for the reminder, Dana. Noted: expense reports are due this Friday (Oct 16)."

Oct 16 is the Friday after today on the simulation clock (Wednesday, Oct 14). I didn't look up an official expense deadline anywhere, so that date comes only from Dana's message. They didn't ask for anything beyond the reminder, so I didn't read any channels or files, or set up a calendar reminder.
